findings.issue: `pending_articles_repo.py` is contradictory and unassigned. Architecture > 'What we're building/modifying' (line 38-39) lists it as MODIFIED ('the 30-day fingerprint window query'), while Dependencies > 'Using existing' (line 149-150) lists the same `list_recent_*_fingerprints` (window param 30) as used AS-IS. No Implementation Task has `pending_articles_repo.py` in 'Files to modify' — Task 4 lists it only under 'Files to read'. So either the 30-day window query is real code work that no task owns, or the file is mislabeled as 'modifying'.
findings.fix: Resolve the contradiction: if the window query needs a code change, add `pending_articles_repo.py` (+ its test) to Task 4's 'Files to modify'; if `list_recent_*_fingerprints` already accepts the window arg and is called with 30 unchanged, remove it from Architecture 'What we're building/modifying' and keep it only under 'Using existing'.

summary: Template-compliant and structurally sound: all required sections present (incl. User-Spec Deviations), frontmatter valid (created/status=draft/branch=dev/size=L), every decision cites an AC or is marked [TECHNICAL], 11 tasks (<=15) organized into Wave 1-3 + Audit Wave (3 auditors, reviewers:none) + Final Wave (pre-deploy QA + post-deploy). Wave-conflict scan is CLEAN — no two same-wave tasks touch the same file, dependencies flow W1->W2->W3 with no cycles. All skills are valid catalog entries; no prompt work miswired to code-writing. No effort-based time estimates (the 2-week post-deploy window is a legitimate monitoring SLA, not a sequencing estimate). Status approved (zero critical). One MAJOR to resolve before decomposition: `pending_articles_repo.py` is both labeled 'modifying' and 'using existing' yet owned by no task — clarify or assign. Four minors: Decision 6 missing Alternatives; Task 4 lacks a Verify-smoke; Task 6 uses non-catalog reviewer documentation-reviewer (exists); Decision 5 hard-codes a fragile line range.
